items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Closes Record IPO Raising ~$93.5 Billion with Full Greenshoe Exercised
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic完成創紀錄IPO，募集約935億美元並全額行使超額配售權
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, Anthropic announced the closing of its IPO of 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83 each, including full exercise of the underwriters’ 147 million share option. The company received about $91.6 billion; a concurrent private placement to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA and TSMC added roughly $26 billion for combined gross proceeds of about $119.5 billion. Shares trade as ANT on Nasdaq after debuting November 19.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，Anthropic宣布完成1.127億股A類股IPO，每股83美元，包括承銷商全額行使1.47億股超額配售權。公司約獲916億美元；同步私募給AMD、博通、Google、美光、微軟、NVIDIA與台積電約增260億美元，合計總收益約1195億美元。股票於11月19日以ANT代號在納斯達克掛牌。
items_flat.analysis_en: This establishes Anthropic as the first major frontier AI lab to go public, supplying a large capital base for compute and safety work while creating a liquid valuation benchmark. Sustained post-IPO performance will depend on revenue growth and regulatory scrutiny of its dual-class structure.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使Anthropic成為首家上市的主要前沿AI實驗室，為算力與安全工作提供大量資本，並建立流動估值基準。後續表現取決於營收增長與雙重股權結構的監管審查。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common stock from Anthropic at the initial public offering price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日Anthropic, PBC宣布完成其A類普通股首次公開發行，總計1,127,000,000股，公開發行價每股83.00美元，包括承銷商全額行使其從Anthropic以首次公開發行價額外購買147,000,000股A類普通股的選擇權。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Mathematician Claims Claude-Assisted Proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic數學家聲稱與Claude合作證明黎曼猜想
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge posted a note on his personal site stating he believes he and Claude discovered a proof of the Riemann hypothesis (and the generalized version), formalized in Lean. The claim is not an official Anthropic announcement; independent verification is pending and no traditional paper has been released.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，Anthropic數學家Levent Alpöge在個人網站發布筆記，稱相信自己與Claude發現黎曼猜想（及廣義版本）的證明，並以Lean形式化。此非Anthropic官方宣布；獨立驗證尚待進行，且未發布傳統論文。
items_flat.analysis_en: If verified, this would be a landmark demonstration of frontier models contributing to major unsolved mathematical problems, accelerating formalization workflows. The absence of an official lab endorsement and expert skepticism so far keep the claim provisional.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若獲驗證，將成為前沿模型對重大未解數學問題貢獻的里程碑，加速形式化工作流程。目前缺乏實驗室官方背書及專家質疑，使主張仍屬暫時性。
items_flat.quote: I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我相信我與Claude合作，發現了黎曼猜想的證明。

items_flat.title_en: Reuters Reports Meta Muse Agent Mixed Conversations and Accessed Private Data in Testing
items_flat.title_zh: 路透社報導Meta Muse代理在測試中混淆對話並存取私人資料
items_flat.summary_en: A Reuters investigation reviewed more than two dozen internal Meta posts in which employees reported the Muse AI agent sending unsolicited messages about bank balances, purchases, and conversations that appeared to belong to other users, including Signal reminders. Meta described the incidents as isolated; Reuters could not independently confirm the data was real.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透社調查檢視超過二十則Meta內部貼文，員工回報Muse AI代理發送關於銀行餘額、購買及看似屬於其他用戶的對話等未請求訊息，包括Signal提醒。Meta稱事件為孤立；路透社無法獨立確認資料真實性。
items_flat.analysis_en: Early agent products are exposing data-isolation and permission-overreach risks that model benchmarks do not capture. How Meta separates employee testing versions from public releases will shape user trust in personal agents.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 早期代理產品暴露出模型基準未捕捉的資料隔離與權限過度風險。Meta如何區分員工測試版與公開版本，將影響用戶對個人代理的信任。
items_flat.quote: BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57.
items_flat.quote_zh: 順便說，兩個銀行更新，你的 Capital One 餘額是 2722.58 美元，Charles Schwab 餘額是 5899.57 美元。

items_flat.title_en: Google Introduces Gemini 4 Neon Mid-Tier Model with 1M Context
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon中階模型，具備100萬上下文
items_flat.summary_en: On November 18, Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a model adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon and positioned between Hydrogen and Carbon. It is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, offers a 1 million-token context, and is aimed at complex coding, knowledge-work and science tasks with multiple thinking levels.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月18日，Google推出Gemini 4 Neon，由Gemini 4 Carbon改編，定位於Hydrogen與Carbon之間。定價為每百萬輸入token 3美元、輸出15美元，提供100萬token上下文，針對複雜編碼、知識工作與科學任務，具備多種思考層級。
items_flat.analysis_en: Neon aims to deliver frontier-level reasoning at lower cost and higher speed than the top-tier Carbon model, targeting high-frequency complex workflows. Independent benchmark leadership remains mixed across different evaluators.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Neon旨在以比頂級Carbon更低成本與更高速度提供前沿級推理，針對高頻複雜工作流程。不同評估者間的獨立基準領先地位仍有分歧。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日我們推出 Gemini 4 Neon——為複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學工作流程帶來前沿級智慧與快速端到端任務完成能力。

items_flat.title_en: Meta Highlights Open-Source AI for Science Summit, Releases UMA Nitro
items_flat.title_zh: Meta強調開源AI科學峰會，發布UMA Nitro
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, Meta published a recap of its Open Source AI for Science Summit. It announced expansion of the Digital Brain Project data target from 15,000 to 25,000 hours and released UMA Nitro, a faster version of its Universal Model for Atoms, along with education tools such as UMA Playground.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，Meta發布開源AI科學峰會回顧。宣布將數位大腦計畫資料目標從15,000小時擴大至25,000小時，並發布UMA Nitro（其通用原子模型的加速版），以及UMA Playground等教育工具。
items_flat.analysis_en: Meta continues positioning open models as infrastructure for scientific discovery rather than only consumer products. The practical impact depends on adoption by external researchers and the speed gains UMA Nitro actually delivers in production simulations.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Meta持續將開源模型定位為科學發現基礎設施，而非僅消費產品。實際影響取決於外部研究者採用程度，以及UMA Nitro在生產模擬中實際帶來的速度提升。
items_flat.quote: At the summit, we released UMA Nitro, a faster version of Meta’s Universal Model for Atoms.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在峰會上，我們發布了UMA Nitro，這是Meta原子通用模型的更快版本。

items_flat.title_en: Google Adds Computer Use to Gemini App for Mac
items_flat.title_zh: Google為Mac版Gemini應用程式加入電腦使用功能
items_flat.summary_en: On November 19, Google announced that computer use is now available in the Gemini app for Mac. The feature lets Gemini navigate local files, desktop apps, and websites in an isolated background window with a live preview in chat, while users retain control of their main screen and can approve actions. It is initially available in English in the US for Google AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra subscribers on Apple Silicon Macs.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月19日，Google宣布Mac版Gemini應用程式現已提供電腦使用功能。該功能讓Gemini在隔離背景視窗中導航本機檔案、桌面應用與網站，並在聊天中提供即時預覽，用戶保留主畫面控制並可批准動作。初期僅限美國英語、Apple Silicon Mac上的Google AI Plus、Pro與Ultra訂閱者。
items_flat.analysis_en: This brings Gemini closer to the computer-use capabilities already offered by competitors and expands practical agentic workflows on the desktop. Limited geographic and subscription availability means most users will wait for broader rollout.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使Gemini更接近競爭對手已提供的電腦使用能力，並擴展桌面上的實用代理工作流程。有限的地理與訂閱可用性意味多數用戶需等待更廣泛推出。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, computer use in the Gemini app for Mac helps you get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，Mac版Gemini應用程式中的電腦使用功能協助您跨本機檔案、桌面應用與網路完成多步驟任務。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Introduces MedChemBench for Medicinal Chemistry Reasoning
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出MedChemBench用於藥物化學推理
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, OpenAI released MedChemBench, a 99-problem retrospective benchmark drawn from papers and patents that tests models on molecular structure interpretation, experimental evidence use, compound selection, and property prediction. At the xhigh setting, GPT-6.2 Astra scored 84.5% of available credit; structure reconstruction was strong while selection and numerical prediction remained harder.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，OpenAI發布MedChemBench，一項從論文與專利抽取的99題回溯基準，測試模型在分子結構解讀、實驗證據使用、化合物選擇與性質預測上的能力。在xhigh設定下，GPT-6.2 Astra獲得84.5%可用分數；結構重建強，但選擇與數值預測仍較難。
items_flat.analysis_en: Specialized scientific benchmarks like MedChemBench highlight where frontier models are gaining practical utility in research workflows, but remaining gaps in ranking and numerical prediction show limits of current capabilities. Contamination risk from published sources is acknowledged by OpenAI.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 像MedChemBench這類專門科學基準突顯前沿模型在研究工作流程中逐漸獲得實用性，但排名與數值預測的剩餘差距顯示當前能力限制。OpenAI已承認來自已發表來源的污染風險。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing MedChemBench, a benchmark that evaluates AI models on reasoning tasks drawn from medicinal chemistry research.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出MedChemBench，一項評估AI模型在藥物化學研究中推理任務的基準。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out ChatGPT Space to Plus Users
items_flat.summary_en: Starting November 20, ChatGPT Space is rolling out globally to Plus users ages 18 and older. Space lets users create interactive pages and presentations, invite collaborators, and set content to update from connected apps; it replaces Library. Dot agents remain limited or unavailable for most Plus users.
items_flat.summary_zh: 自11月20日起，ChatGPT Space正全球推廣至18歲以上Plus用戶。Space讓用戶建立互動頁面與簡報、邀請協作者，並設定從連接應用更新內容；它取代Library。Dot代理對多數Plus用戶仍受限或不可用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extending collaborative workspace features to the broader Plus tier accelerates OpenAI’s push into agentic productivity tools, though Dot agent access remains limited for Plus users. Adoption will depend on how well the feature integrates with existing ChatGPT workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將協作工作空間功能擴展至更廣的Plus層級，加速OpenAI推進代理生產力工具，但Plus用戶的Dot代理存取仍受限。採用程度取決於該功能與現有ChatGPT工作流程的整合程度。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, ChatGPT Space is rolling out globally to Plus users ages 18 and older.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，ChatGPT Space 開始向全球 18 歲以上 Plus 用戶推出。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Shares Research on Combating Model Distillation
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI分享對抗模型蒸餾的研究
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, OpenAI posted about new research on distillation of its models, covering how capabilities transfer, detection of coordinated attempts, and defenses that help sharpen industry-wide safeguards. Internal evaluations showed reasoning-extraction attack success rates dropping sharply on GPT-6.2 models with updated protections.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月20日，OpenAI發布關於其模型蒸餾的新研究，涵蓋能力如何轉移、協調嘗試的偵測，以及有助強化產業整體防護的防禦。內部評估顯示，更新防護後GPT-6.2模型上的推理提取攻擊成功率大幅下降。
items_flat.analysis_en: As open and closed models proliferate, official work on distillation defenses addresses a practical security concern for labs that invest heavily in frontier training. Effectiveness outside controlled evaluations remains an open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 隨著開源與封閉模型激增，官方對蒸餾防禦的工作解決了對前沿訓練投入大量資源的實驗室所面臨的實際安全疑慮。受控評估之外的有效性仍是未解問題。
items_flat.quote: Distillation can reproduce powerful AI capabilities without the safeguards built around them.
items_flat.quote_zh: 蒸餾可以在沒有周圍防護的情況下重現強大的AI能力。

google.analysis_zh: Neon旨在以比頂級Carbon更低成本與更高速度提供前沿級推理，針對高頻複雜工作流程。不同評估者間的獨立基準領先地位仍有分歧。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
google.quote_zh: 今日我們推出 Gemini 4 Neon——為複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學工作流程帶來前沿級智慧與快速端到端任務完成能力。

google.title_en: Google Adds Computer Use to Gemini App for Mac
google.title_zh: Google為Mac版Gemini應用程式加入電腦使用功能
google.summary_en: On November 19, Google announced that computer use is now available in the Gemini app for Mac. The feature lets Gemini navigate local files, desktop apps, and websites in an isolated background window with a live preview in chat, while users retain control of their main screen and can approve actions. It is initially available in English in the US for Google AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra subscribers on Apple Silicon Macs.
google.summary_zh: 11月19日，Google宣布Mac版Gemini應用程式現已提供電腦使用功能。該功能讓Gemini在隔離背景視窗中導航本機檔案、桌面應用與網站，並在聊天中提供即時預覽，用戶保留主畫面控制並可批准動作。初期僅限美國英語、Apple Silicon Mac上的Google AI Plus、Pro與Ultra訂閱者。
google.analysis_en: This brings Gemini closer to the computer-use capabilities already offered by competitors and expands practical agentic workflows on the desktop. Limited geographic and subscription availability means most users will wait for broader rollout.
google.analysis_zh: 這使Gemini更接近競爭對手已提供的電腦使用能力，並擴展桌面上的實用代理工作流程。有限的地理與訂閱可用性意味多數用戶需等待更廣泛推出。
google.quote: Starting today, computer use in the Gemini app for Mac helps you get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web.
google.quote_zh: 即日起，Mac版Gemini應用程式中的電腦使用功能協助您跨本機檔案、桌面應用與網路完成多步驟任務。

meta.title_en: Reuters Reports Meta Muse Agent Mixed Conversations and Accessed Private Data in Testing
meta.title_zh: 路透社報導Meta Muse代理在測試中混淆對話並存取私人資料
meta.summary_en: A Reuters investigation reviewed more than two dozen internal Meta posts in which employees reported the Muse AI agent sending unsolicited messages about bank balances, purchases, and conversations that appeared to belong to other users, including Signal reminders. Meta described the incidents as isolated; Reuters could not independently confirm the data was real.
meta.summary_zh: 路透社調查檢視超過二十則Meta內部貼文，員工回報Muse AI代理發送關於銀行餘額、購買及看似屬於其他用戶的對話等未請求訊息，包括Signal提醒。Meta稱事件為孤立；路透社無法獨立確認資料真實性。
meta.analysis_en: Early agent products are exposing data-isolation and permission-overreach risks that model benchmarks do not capture. How Meta separates employee testing versions from public releases will shape user trust in personal agents.
meta.analysis_zh: 早期代理產品暴露出模型基準未捕捉的資料隔離與權限過度風險。Meta如何區分員工測試版與公開版本，將影響用戶對個人代理的信任。
meta.quote: BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57.
meta.quote_zh: 順便說，兩個銀行更新，你的 Capital One 餘額是 2722.58 美元，Charles Schwab 餘額是 5899.57 美元。

meta.title_en: Meta Highlights Open-Source AI for Science Summit, Releases UMA Nitro
meta.title_zh: Meta強調開源AI科學峰會，發布UMA Nitro
meta.summary_en: On November 20, Meta published a recap of its Open Source AI for Science Summit. It announced expansion of the Digital Brain Project data target from 15,000 to 25,000 hours and released UMA Nitro, a faster version of its Universal Model for Atoms, along with education tools such as UMA Playground.
meta.summary_zh: 11月20日，Meta發布開源AI科學峰會回顧。宣布將數位大腦計畫資料目標從15,000小時擴大至25,000小時，並發布UMA Nitro（其通用原子模型的加速版），以及UMA Playground等教育工具。
meta.analysis_en: Meta continues positioning open models as infrastructure for scientific discovery rather than only consumer products. The practical impact depends on adoption by external researchers and the speed gains UMA Nitro actually delivers in production simulations.
meta.analysis_zh: Meta持續將開源模型定位為科學發現基礎設施，而非僅消費產品。實際影響取決於外部研究者採用程度，以及UMA Nitro在生產模擬中實際帶來的速度提升。
meta.quote: At the summit, we released UMA Nitro, a faster version of Meta’s Universal Model for Atoms.
meta.quote_zh: 在峰會上，我們發布了UMA Nitro，這是Meta原子通用模型的更快版本。

brief_en: Anthropic closed its record ~$93.5B IPO and saw an employee claim a Claude-assisted Riemann hypothesis proof (unverified). Meta faced Reuters reports of Muse agent data mix-ups; Google advanced Gemini computer use on Mac and Neon model; OpenAI released MedChemBench and distillation defenses while expanding ChatGPT Space.
brief_zh: Anthropic完成約935億美元IPO，員工聲稱與Claude合作證明黎曼猜想（尚未驗證）。Meta遭報導Muse代理資料混淆；Google推進Gemini Mac電腦使用與Neon模型；OpenAI推出MedChemBench與蒸餾防禦，並擴展ChatGPT Space。
